changes.comment: The hosting application can now fully control outgoing map-layer requests: MapLayerFormatRegistry.setMapLayerFetchHandler registers a handler wrapping every map-layer send like a .NET DelegatingHandler - it may send a copy of the request with other headers and query parameters (e.g. inject an Authorization header for services behind an authenticating proxy), retry transparently after refreshing a token, short-circuit, or throw the now-public MapLayerAuthenticationFailedError to transition layers to RequireAuth. Applies to tiles, tooltips, capabilities, service metadata and source validation across all map-layer formats; sends issued through the handler follow the trusted-origins redirect policy and never trigger SSO retries unless the handler passes fetchRequest(request, { credentialed: false }) for requests it leaves untouched; URL-keyed metadata caches are bypassed while a handler is registered. Also fixed: WMS/WMTS GetCapabilities requests issued when a layer initializes now include the layer's custom query parameters, matching source validation.
